spec.description: Every ship the Danish Maritime Authority's AIS network heard in the last week it published, read as trajectories: where ships stopped, the trips between their stops, the busiest ports and waters, and the ships that lay together at sea; the analysis of MovingPandas, Trackintel and scikit-mobility, in DuckDB. Click a kind of ship to filter, a ship to follow it. Needs the recorder (compose profile `recorder`). Data: Danish Maritime Authority, open data.

options.content: **Every ship the Danish Maritime Authority's AIS network heard**, a day at a time, read as trajectories: where each ship **stopped** (half an hour or more under half a knot), the **trips** between its stops, the **places** where many ships stop, the **encounters** where two ships lay together at sea, and how busy each stretch of water was. The same analysis [MovingPandas](https://movingpandas.org), [Trackintel](https://github.com/mie-lab/trackintel) and [scikit-mobility](https://scikit-mobility.github.io/scikit-mobility/) do in Python and [MobilityDB](https://mobilitydb.com) in PostgreSQL, here in DuckDB: [`recorder/feeds/ais-denmark.sql`](https://github.com/ubica-ecuador/pacha/blob/main/recorder/feeds/ais-denmark.sql). **Click a kind of ship** to filter by it; **click a ship** in the trips or encounters tables to follow it.

spec.rawSql:
-- Hours of presence per hour are the ships there on average in that hour.
SELECT hour AS time, kind, round(sum(ship_hours)) AS ships
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/cells.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring})
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time

spec.description: The hours ships spent in the network's waters in each hour: how many were there on average. Times in UTC.
spec.title: Ships in the water, hour by hour

spec.rawSql:
-- Ships on average in each cell (H3 resolution 7) over the days picked: hours
-- of presence divided by the hours in those days.
WITH days AS (
  SELECT greatest(count(*), 1) AS n FROM unnest([${dirs:singlequote}]) AS t(d) WHERE d NOT LIKE '%-empty'
)
SELECT h3_h3_to_string(cell) AS h3, round(sum(ship_hours) / (24 * any_value(days.n)), 3) AS ships
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/cells.parquet'), union_by_name = true), days
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring})
GROUP BY cell

spec.description: Ships on average in each H3 cell (about 5 km²) over the days picked, for the kind of ship picked. The shipping lanes through the Great Belt, the Sound and around Skagen stand out.
spec.title: How busy the water is

spec.rawSql:
-- Two ships within 500 m, both under 2 knots, for an hour or more, away from
-- ports and anchorages.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT coalesce(a.name, e.mmsi_a::VARCHAR) || ' × ' || coalesce(b.name, e.mmsi_b::VARCHAR) AS "Ships",
       e.kind_a || ' × ' || e.kind_b AS "Kinds",
       e.start_ts AS "From", round(e.minutes / 60, 1) AS "Hours", e.closest_m AS "Closest, m",
       e.median_m AS "Median, m",
       CASE WHEN e.with_service THEN 'With a service ship' ELSE 'Between other ships' END AS "Meeting",
       round(e.lat, 4) AS latitude, round(e.lon, 4) AS longitude,
       e.mmsi_a || ',' || e.mmsi_b AS pair
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/encounters.parquet'), union_by_name = true) e
LEFT JOIN ships a ON a.mmsi = e.mmsi_a
LEFT JOIN ships b ON b.mmsi = e.mmsi_b
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR e.kind_a = ${kind:sqlstring} OR e.kind_b = ${kind:sqlstring})
  AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), e.mmsi_a::VARCHAR)
       OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), e.mmsi_b::VARCHAR))
ORDER BY e.minutes DESC

spec.rawSql:
-- Ships by kind, from the type each declares. The kind picked stays drawn,
-- so the bars can switch it.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT kind AS value, kind AS label, count(*) AS ships
FROM ships
WHERE (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), mmsi::VARCHAR))
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY ships DESC

spec.description: Ships heard in the days picked, by the type each declares; Other is a ship that declares none, or one of a rare type. Click a bar to filter the whole dashboard by it.
spec.title: Kind of ship

options.content:
### How it is read

| | What it is here | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Positions** | Class A and B ships only, one position every 30 s. A fix the ship would have had to reach and leave at over 50 knots is dropped. | MovingPandas' cleaning |
| **Stop** | Half an hour or more with the speed, smoothed over two minutes, under half a knot. Two still spells less than 15 minutes and 500 m apart are one stop. *Moored* and *at anchor* are what the ship said; *stopped*, that it said neither. | MovingPandas' stop detector, Trackintel's staypoints |
| **Trip** | What lies between two stops, broken where a ship went unheard for two hours. Under a kilometre is no trip. | Trackintel's triplegs |
| **Place** | The H3 cell (resolution 7, about 5 km²) where a stop lies. Its name is the destination most often declared by the ships whose trips end there: a good guess at the port, not a gazetteer. | Trackintel's locations |
| **Encounter** | Two ships within 500 m, both under 2 knots, for an hour or more, neither moored nor made fast to a quay, and away from ports and anchorages (where five ships stopped that day, and two cells around). | Global Fishing Watch's encounters, over a day instead of months |
| **Busy water** | Hours of presence per H3 cell: each position counts until the next, five minutes at most. Divided by the hours in the days picked, it is the ships there on average. | scikit-mobility's tessellations |

**Days.** The authority publishes each day two or three days later; the recorder (compose profile `recorder`) reads each new one, about 650 MB zipped, and keeps the last seven. A day is read on its own, so a stop or trip across midnight is cut there: the trips table leaves those out, and most ships that cross these waters without stopping are among them.

**Not here.** AIS says what a ship's own instruments and crew put in it: names, types and destinations can be wrong or missing (a third of the ships declare no type, and count as *Other*), and a ship with its transponder off is not heard. Coverage thins out beyond about 40 nautical miles from the Danish coast.

Data: [Danish Maritime Authority, historical AIS data](http://aisdata.ais.dk/), open data under Denmark's act on the re-use of public sector information.

spec.rawSql:
-- The places with most ships stopping, named by the destination ships
-- arriving there declared.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
),
names AS (
  SELECT t.to_place AS place, mode(upper(trim(s.destination))) AS port
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/trips.parquet'), union_by_name = true) t JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
  WHERE s.destination IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(s.destination)) > 1
  GROUP BY t.to_place
),
st AS (
  SELECT st.*, s.kind FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/stops.parquet'), union_by_name = true) st JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
  WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), st.mmsi::VARCHAR))
)
SELECT coalesce(n.port, '–') AS "Ships heading here said",
       count(DISTINCT st.mmsi) AS "Ships", count(*) AS "Stops",
       round(median(st.minutes) / 60, 1) AS "Median stay, h",
       round(100 * avg((st.how = 'Moored')::INTEGER)) AS "Moored, %",
       round(100 * avg((st.how = 'At anchor')::INTEGER)) AS "At anchor, %",
       mode(st.kind) AS "Most are",
       round(h3_cell_to_lat(st.place), 3) AS "Lat", round(h3_cell_to_lng(st.place), 3) AS "Lon"
FROM st LEFT JOIN names n USING (place)
GROUP BY st.place, n.port
ORDER BY "Ships" DESC
LIMIT 100

spec.description: The places where most ships stopped, named by the destination most often declared by the ships arriving: a good guess at the port. Moored and at anchor are what the ships said.
spec.title: Busiest places to stop

spec.rawSql:
-- The ships followed: speed over ground, every 30 s.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT t.ts AS time, coalesce(s.name, t.mmsi::VARCHAR) AS name, t.sog AS knots
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/tracks.parquet'), union_by_name = true) t JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
WHERE ${ships:sqlstring} <> '' AND list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), t.mmsi::VARCHAR)
ORDER BY name, time

spec.description: The speed each ship followed reported, every 30 s, over the days picked. Clear filters to stop following.
spec.title: Ships followed: speed over ground

spec.rawSql:
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
),
picked AS (SELECT mmsi FROM ships WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), mmsi::VARCHAR)))
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM picked) AS "Ships heard",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/stops.parquet'), union_by_name = true) SEMI JOIN picked USING (mmsi)) AS "Stops",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/trips.parquet'), union_by_name = true) SEMI JOIN picked USING (mmsi)) AS "Trips",
  (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(km), 0) / 1.852) FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/trips.parquet'), union_by_name = true) SEMI JOIN picked USING (mmsi)) AS "Nautical miles sailed",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/encounters.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
   WHERE mmsi_a IN (SELECT mmsi FROM picked) OR mmsi_b IN (SELECT mmsi FROM picked)) AS "Encounters at sea"

spec.description: For the days picked and the filters. Nautical miles add up the trips, from one 30-second position to the next.

spec.rawSql:
-- Places where ships stop (H3 resolution 7, about 5 km2): how many ships.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT h3_h3_to_string(st.place) AS h3, count(DISTINCT st.mmsi) AS ships, count(*) AS stops,
       round(median(st.minutes) / 60, 1) AS median_hours
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/stops.parquet'), union_by_name = true) st JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), st.mmsi::VARCHAR))
GROUP BY st.place

-- Every stop: where the ship lay, how long, moored, at anchor or just stopped.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT s.name, s.kind, st.lat AS latitude, st.lon AS longitude, st.how,
       round(st.minutes / 60, 1) AS hours, st.radius_m
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/stops.parquet'), union_by_name = true) st JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), st.mmsi::VARCHAR))
ORDER BY st.minutes DESC
LIMIT 30000

spec.description: Every stop, sized by how long it lasted and coloured by what the ship said it was doing; under them, the places (H3 cells of about 5 km²) by how many ships stopped there.
spec.title: Where ships stop

spec.rawSql:
-- A trip id, a time and a position: the panel builds an animated Trip layer.
-- Every trip of the ships the filters let through, one position every five
-- minutes for each day picked (five minutes for one day, 35 for a week),
-- or the ships followed, every 30 s, stops and all, as one trail each.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
),
days AS (
  SELECT greatest(count(*), 1) AS n FROM unnest([${dirs:singlequote}]) AS t(d) WHERE d NOT LIKE '%-empty'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN ${ships:sqlstring} <> '' THEN s.name || ' (' || t.mmsi || ')' ELSE t.trip_id END AS trip_id,
       t.ts AS time, t.lat AS latitude, t.lon AS longitude, t.kind,
       coalesce(s.name, t.mmsi::VARCHAR) AS name, t.sog AS knots
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/tracks.parquet'), union_by_name = true) t JOIN ships s USING (mmsi), days
WHERE CASE WHEN ${ships:sqlstring} <> '' THEN list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), t.mmsi::VARCHAR)
           ELSE t.trip_id IS NOT NULL AND epoch(t.ts)::BIGINT % (300 * days.n) < 30
                AND (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR t.kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) END
ORDER BY trip_id, time
LIMIT 150000

-- Where the ships followed stopped; nothing when none is followed.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
)
SELECT s.name, st.lat AS latitude, st.lon AS longitude, st.how, st.minutes,
       strftime(st.start_ts, '%a %d %H:%M') || ' to ' || strftime(st.end_ts, '%a %d %H:%M') AS stayed
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/stops.parquet'), union_by_name = true) st JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
WHERE ${ships:sqlstring} <> '' AND list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), st.mmsi::VARCHAR)

spec.description: Every trip of the kind of ship picked, replayed: press ▶. One position every five minutes per day picked; one day shows the most detail. Following ships (from the tables), their whole days, every 30 s, with the stops in white. Up to 150,000 positions.
spec.title: Trips, replayed

spec.rawSql:
-- The longest trips from one stop to the next. A trip cut by midnight is not
-- here: the ships crossing these waters without stopping are most of those.
WITH ships AS (
  -- What each ship said of itself, its latest day.
  SELECT mmsi, arg_max(name, day) AS name, arg_max(kind, day) AS kind,
         arg_max(ship_type, day) AS ship_type, arg_max(destination, day) AS destination
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/vessels.parquet'), union_by_name = true)
  GROUP BY mmsi
),
names AS (
  SELECT t.to_place AS place, mode(upper(trim(s.destination))) AS port
  FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/trips.parquet'), union_by_name = true) t JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
  WHERE s.destination IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(s.destination)) > 1
  GROUP BY t.to_place
)
SELECT coalesce(s.name, t.mmsi::VARCHAR) AS "Ship", s.kind AS "Kind",
       t.start_ts AS "Left", round(t.minutes / 60, 1) AS "Hours",
       round(t.km / 1.852) AS "Nautical miles", t.avg_kn AS "Avg knots", t.max_kn AS "Max knots",
       coalesce(nf.port, '–') AS "From", coalesce(nt.port, '–') AS "To",
       t.mmsi::VARCHAR AS mmsi
FROM read_parquet(list_transform([${dirs:singlequote}], d -> d || '/trips.parquet'), union_by_name = true) t JOIN ships s USING (mmsi)
LEFT JOIN names nf ON nf.place = t.from_place
LEFT JOIN names nt ON nt.place = t.to_place
WHERE (${kind:sqlstring} = '' OR kind = ${kind:sqlstring}) AND (${ships:sqlstring} = '' OR list_contains(string_split(${ships:sqlstring}, ','), t.mmsi::VARCHAR))
  AND t.from_place IS NOT NULL AND t.to_place IS NOT NULL AND NOT t.cut_start AND NOT t.cut_end
ORDER BY t.km DESC
LIMIT 200

spec.description: Trips from one stop to the next within a day, longest first; From and To are the places' likely ports. A ferry turning round in under half an hour sails on in the same trip. Click a ship to follow it.
spec.title: Port to port: the longest trips
